text:
Maya: quick heads-up — kicking off sampler robustness check across 3 models: ozma-mini, rwd-70b-ft-int8, llama2-70b-quant. goal: find failure modes for sampling combos (temp, topk/top_p, batch). looking for hallucination spikes, repetition, latency variance. anyone run something similar?

Arjun: ran a tiny sweep on ozma-mini earlier. temp 0.7 + topk50 vs topk5. topk5 -> safe but low diversity; topk50 -> more diverse but token churn and occasional repetition. latency diff ~18ms -> 25ms/token at batch=8. still CPU-bound on our small infra.

Sophie: on rwd-70b-ft int8 i saw a measurable QA drop at low-topk (<=10) when prefix cache misses happen. answers became shorter and sometimes omitted entities. created quick eval set and some examples: https://internal/redwood/evals/17382 (share if you need raw logs)

Tom: did adversarial QA + long-context story. noticed beam-y loops when temp < 0.3 + top_p >= 0.95 — model tends to stick to a phrase. might be sampling degeneracy not beam search. suggestion: add a min-entropy gate or force occasional jitter on logits.

Maya: good notes. can we standardize metrics for this sprint? proposing: exact-match accuracy (for QA), repetition-rate (n-gram repeats), self-consistency (majority across seeds), latency p50/p95, token-cost delta, and a fail-mode tag (hallucination / loop / truncation). anyone want to add?

Arjun: add prefix-cache-staleness metric — measure KL drift of attention keys after N tokens (100/300/600). saw drift in quant models around 600 tokens. could be numeric rounding in KV.

Sophie: + log of top-5 token distributions for flagged cases. helps debug whether mass shifted to wrong token cluster. also capture last-attention-weights snapshot.

Tom: i can run an adversarial sweep (1000 prompts) tonight. will vary temp [0.0,0.2,0.5,0.8], topk [5,20,50], topp [0.85,0.9,0.95], batch [1,4,8]. estimate run time ~3h on our bench.

Maya: awesome. i'll spin up a small harness. basic command i'll use:
```
./run_sampler_check --model rwd-70b-ft-int8 --seed 42 --temps 0.0,0.2,0.5,0.8 --topks 5,20,50 --topps 0.85,0.9,0.95 --batch 1,4,8 --out /tmp/173820_runs
```

Maya: plan: 1) smoke run to validate infra 2) full sweep 3) aggregate metrics + triage top 20 failures 4) sanity readout to eng-oncall if huge QoL regressions.

EvalBot: scheduled jobs: 1738200123-1 (ozma sweep), 1738200123-2 (rwd-70b-ft-int8 sweep), 1738200123-3 (llama2-70b-quant sweep). will post progress.

Arjun: small gotcha — when running mixed-quant vs fp16 on same deployment, ensure kernel fallback logs enabled. i saw silent fallback that inflated latency but not flagged by our harness.

Sophie: also capture permutation-bias tests (reorder prompt clauses). quant models sometimes prefer earlier tokens.

Tom: once sweeps finish i'll upload raw outputs to /shared/eng-ml/173820/ and add a short tldr with highlight failures.

Maya: thanks — let's sync tomorrow 10am PT. if any of you see catastrophic hallucination/regression tag with :rotating_light: and ping eng-oncall. :+1:
